Author: strawhatwem

[center]Thank you to everyone for your support during Modfest! Happy 10th Anniversary, Stardew!

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1772319257.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿[/b]
Tilly landed in Pelican Town a year before you did, after being forced to close down her bookshop in Zuzu City thanks to JojaCorp. Now she's rebuilding her confidence and finding a new direction in life.

She lives above the Blacksmith and, much to her dismay, below Jojamart. After moving to Pelican Town, she was hired part-time at the Museum by Gunther, who now has more time to focus on research. Between her shifts, Tilly reads, tends to her garden of fruits and tea leaves, and makes many an attempt at binding her own books.

She can be a bit negative at times, but she swears she's working on it! Don't take her comments personally, but do take her seriously. It's easy to mistake her fire for confidence. You'll soon discover otherwise.[/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1773021480.gif[/img]﻿﻿

Please play from a new save or before the Movie Theatre is completed to access all heart events and story beats!

If you want to [b]add her to a save where these are already done[/b], please type [b]debug ebi Wem.Bundle.Tilly_4Hearts.2 [/b]into your SMAPI console so the first required event plays!

[size=5][b]Config Guide[/b][/size]
[quote][b]"Tilly's Route"[/b]
Allows you to choose whether or not you want to play the romantic, platonic, or Joja version of her Tea Shop story.

[b]MUST [/b]check articles for the full guide so you know what you're getting into. 

In general, please select the route you want to play with as soon as you download this mod to minimize issues.

These routes are designed to be played as intended! If you are going Joja, choose Joja in the config. If not, choose platonic or romantic.

[b]"Tilly's House Location"[/b]
Allows you to choose between two locations: Above the blacksmith, and below Penny's trailer. This will apply for both Vanilla AND SVE players.
Choose "Below Penny" for compat with Haley's Bakery and to avoid visual clashing with some ES events.

[b]"Nyapu-Style portraits"[/b]
Allows you to toggle the portraits to use my Nyapu-style portraits. 

[b]"Lunar New Year Stand"
[/b]Allows you to toggle whether or not Tilly has a special LNY schedule. Default true.

[b]"Joja Route Trigger Length"
[/b]Allows you decide the length of time (7 to 28 days) to pass before the Joja Route starts. Check the Events section for more info. Default 28 days.

[b]"Darcy Location"[/b]
Allows you to choose which location Darcy's Coffee Shop is using for the crossover event to work.

[b]"Hair Type - Girl" and "Hair Type - Boy"[/b]
Allows you to choose which hair type to use for your children with Tilly.[/quote]
[size=5][b]﻿Schedule[/b][/size]
[i]Please use Lookup Anything to see Tilly's schedule per day. Her schedule varies quite a bit (by design).[/i]

[b]Spring 8, Lunar New Year
[/b][i]Must have the Lunar New Year Stand config turned on.[/i]
8 AM: Tilly opens the Lunar New Year snack stand (where the ice cream stand is)
7 PM: Tilly heads home to call her parents.
10 PM: Tilly goes to bed.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1772342969.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[quote][b]Please note that 5 Hearts, 6 Hearts 1+ 2, 7 Hearts 2, 8 Hearts 1, and her family events will be inaccessible in the Joja route. Otherwise, the events below are accessible no matter which route you pick. 

1 Heart[/b]
﻿﻿Enter Pierre's on a sunny Friday.

[b]2 Hearts
[/b]Enter the Museum between 9 AM and 5 PM on a rainy day when she's there.

[b]4 Hearts #1[/b]
Enter Tilly's house between 10 AM and 10 PM when she's there.

[b]4 Hearts #2 [/b]
Enter Town on a sunny day between 9 AM to 5 PM. You must not have completed the Community Center. 

[b]5 Heart Event
[/b]Enter Tilly's house between 9 AM and 10 PM. Must have seen 4 Hearts #2.

[b]6 Hearts #1[/b]
Enter Tilly's house between 9 AM between 10 PM when she's there. 

[b]6 Hearts #2
[/b]Enter the Saloon betwen 5PM and 10 PM when she's there. Must have seen 6 Hearts #1, and at least 10 days must have passed since then. Must have seen Leah's 2-Heart event and Elliott's 6-Heart event. 

[b]7 Hearts #1[/b]
Enter Tilly's house between 11 AM and 4 PM, having received a certain invitation and with a certain item in your inventory. 

[b]7 Hearts #2
[/b]Triggers immediately after Elliott's 8-heart event. Must have seen 6-Hearts #2.

[b]8 Hearts #1[/b]
Must be dating Tilly. Enter her house between 9 AM to 10 PM. 

[b]8 Hearts #2
[/b]Dating not required. Enter her house between 9 AM and 10 PM while she's there. Must have seen 7 Hearts #2.

[b]8 Hearts #3
[/b]Dating not required. Enter the Forest between 8 PM and 12 AM on a sunny day. Can't be winter.

[b]10 Heart: Pottery Painting Date
[/b]Must be dating Tilly. Enter the Bus Stop between 9 AM and 4 PM.

[b]Beekeeping Event #1[/b]
Year 2. Enter Town on a sunny day between 9 AM to 5 PM. Must have 5 hearts with Tilly.

[b][size=4]Tilly's Tea Shop Storyline[/size][/b]
[size=3]All information is available under the "Tilly's Route Guide" article. [/size]

[b][i]OTHER EVENTS[/i][/b]
[spoiler][b]Book Recommendations [/b]
Sam: Enter the Museum between 9 AM and 5 PM when Tilly is there. Must have 2 Hearts with Sam.
Sandy: Enter the Museum between 9 AM and 5 PM when Tilly is there. Must have 2 Hearts with Sandy.
Clint: Enter the Museum between 9 AM and 5 PM on a non-sunny day when Tilly is there. Must have 2 Hearts with Clint.
Jas: Enter the Museum between 9 AM and 5 PM when Tilly is there. Must have 2 Hearts with Jas and Marnie. 

[b]Red Envelope Event + Quest [/b]
Exit the Farmhouse on Spring 8, 9, or 10 between 6 AM and 5 PM.

[b]Shopping with Haley[/b]
Enter Haley's house between 9 AM and 7 PM. Must have 2 Hearts with Tilly. 

[b]Dyeing Hair with Emily
[/b]Enter Emily's house between 9 AM and 7 PM. Must have 2 Hearts with Tilly and Haley.

[b]Alex's Tea Eggs[/b]
Enter Alex's house. Must have received the Tea Egg recipe. 

[b]Caroline's Sunroom[/b]
Enter Caroline's sunroom any time during the last week of the month. Must have seen Caroline's 2-Heart event. 

[b]Picnic with the Girls
[/b]Arrive at Ginger Island South on a sunny day between 6 AM and 7 PM. Must have the Resort built.

[b]Gossiping with Darcy 
[/b]Must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39520]Darcy's Coffee Shop[/url]﻿ installed. Select the config option that matches her location. 
Enter Pierre's shop between 9 AM and 4 PM on a rainy day. Must have 4 Hearts with both Tilly and Darcy.


[b][i]FARMER'S BIRTHDAY EVENT
[/i][/b]Must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/boxosoup/mods]boxosoup[/url]﻿'s[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43723] Birthday[/url]﻿ mod. Enter the Saloon between 12 and 8 PM on the player's birthday. Not repeatable currently.
[i]

[b]SVE-EXCLUSIVE EVENTS[/b]
[/i]
[b]Sophia's Manga
[/b]Enter Sophia's house. Must have seen Sophia's 2-Heart event. [/spoiler]

[size=2]
In case you're interested! I give explanations for certain choices I made when making this mod, as well as lore you may miss.[/size][/center]
[quote][list]
[*]﻿Tilly is Chinese (or whatever the Stardew equivalent is)! This is referenced in the Tea Egg dish and in one of her events.[/*]
[*]Her Chinese name (made up by my mom) is: ﻿马曼提. Her nickname is ﻿曼﻿曼![/*]
[*]Tilly's 8th portrait (looking to the side) is purposefully used often because she dislikes eye contact with strangers and people in general. It makes her anxious. She looks away much less if you begin dating her.[/*]
[*]Tilly never walks by JojaMart, except during Winter because it's a little too cold to take detours. [/*]
[*]﻿Engagement dialogue doesn’t specify that there are 3 days untl the wedding, in case the length has been changed by a mod[/*]
[*]Tilly wears a bee costume to Spirit's Eve as she finds bees terrifying. Before the festival, she says she wants to look both cute and spooky, so a bee was perfect.  [/*]
[*]Tilly is a bit of a projection of myself, the original OC being somewhat of a sona. However, she is possesses many qualities that I do not and probably never will. I take bits and pieces from my own life and add in details that I think would be interesting. [/*]
[/list][/quote]
